hook.name: NakamotoHook
hook.description: A bonding curve hook that mints NAKAMOTO tokens on ETH buys (curve-priced with a pool-value floor) and burns them on sells (priced by treasury/supply ratio with a 5% exit fee). Liquidity additions are disabled; the hook features a whitelist-gated launch window, a per-buyer sell cooldown, and self-deprecates permanently after 3,000 ETH in cumulative curve purchases.
